experiment.name: SANITIZED_SHALLOW_GIT_ARCHIVE_REPRODUCIBILITY
experiment.design: Create one source Git commit, independently stage that exact commit twice through shallow file:// fetch + detached checkout, remove FETCH_HEAD and reflogs, run git read-tree --reset HEAD, then archive the full staged checkout including .git using fixed GNU tar metadata and gzip -n -9.
experiment.control: Both stages target the identical commit and are clean before serialization.
experiment.expected_if_candidate_is_reproducible: raw tar SHA-256 and gzip SHA-256 are byte-identical across independent stages

grf.observed_anchor: PR761 attempts to reconcile the canonical EntityOS builder's clean exact Git provenance requirement with Vercel source staging by archiving a sanitized shallow exact-head checkout including .git.
grf.hypothesis: Removing transport traces and fixing tar/gzip metadata makes the shallow checkout a reproducible source artifact while retaining Git provenance.
grf.strongest_counterhypothesis: Mutable Git checkout metadata, especially .git/index stat-cache fields, remains stage-instance-dependent and changes the archive bytes even when source HEAD and file tree are identical.
grf.discriminator: Two independent exact-head shallow stages serialized with the candidate canonicalization procedure.

preferred_property_split: bind immutable committed source/tree bytes reproducibly outside the sandbox
inside the sandbox reconstruct or attest only the provenance material required by the canonical builder without admitting checkout-instance metadata
candidate_fusion.warning: Do not weaken build provenance merely to restore a green matrix; prove exact file set, mode, content digest, expected commit binding, and fail-closed mutation controls.

coordination.reason_no_new_sandbox: A coordinated attestation candidate deployment was already queued; starting duplicate compute would violate batch coordination.

exact_entityos_blocker: No current-main or accepted provenance-fused candidate has a fresh successful isolated Vercel Sandbox matrix after the main replay hotfix and build-provenance hardening. PR761 fails before Sandbox start; the attested-snapshot replacement remains queued/unverified.
next_executable_step: Let the already-queued attested-snapshot Vercel preview execute. If it starts a sandbox, require exact source-head/file-manifest/archive binding, mutation-negative controls, double-build identical EntityOS SHA-256, status/self-test, PATH-without-host-Python, relocation/copy execution, DENY_ALL during offline tests, and clean sandbox stop before considering fusion to current main.
